aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us – HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system works from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. With online card payments, Stripe’s fees are added: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card reader takes payment at the hatch. The two complement each other.

comparison.tldr.body: If your customers should order ahead on their phone and choose a collection time, you need an ordering system, not just a till. Look for four things: collection times that follow your kitchen capacity; a weekly schedule for changing locations; low or no fees per order; and no long contract. Card readers and tills cover payment at the hatch and complement an ordering system.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Customers can pre-order for a later day or a later time already before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by period, dish and event and see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically – you don’t need to confirm each one individually.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When handing out a pager, assign its number to the order so you know which pager belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen for customers that shows order numbers and when the orders are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so customers nearby find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date leads directly to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with individual prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen – and the only way to keep accepting orders even without reception.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at the same time and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards – stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle dishes into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to increase the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like the automatic WhatsApp replies, just for enquiries via Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens – counter and kitchen – all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your team their own logins with the appropriate access rights.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose reception, online orders are paused so that customers don’t place orders you don’t see. With the app for iPhone, iPad and Android you keep accepting orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Customers pay directly by card when ordering online – via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an order cut-off for dishes that need notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Create private events that don’t appear on the map – with their own private order link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We enter your dates automatically – from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Notify customers automatically by SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs – we automatically add your dates, locations and times for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any dish as sold out with one tap – it is greyed out for customers immediately.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock level: it counts down with every order, after which the dish is automatically sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Accept card payments on a supported smartphone – with no separate card reader at all.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot – so demand is spread over your whole selling time.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck, paid via your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your business in the browser on any smartphone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and your dates.

landing.does.devicesBody: On the smartphone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck – and the card reader you already take payments with today.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable wifi and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile reception at all. HatchGrab was developed exactly for that.
